question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Inscrutable
solution:
The correct answer is '**Inexplicable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Inscrutable**' is '**Inexplicable**'.
 
• **Inscrutable**: (used about a person or their expression) not showing any emotions and therefore difficult to understand or know. [कोई भावना न व्यक्त करनेवाला इसलिए समझना कठिन; समझ में न आने योग्य; रहस्यमय]
 
 
• *Example: The judge could not find any evidence of guilt on his **inscrutable** face.*
 
 
 
• **Inexplicable**: that cannot be explained. (जिसे समझाया न जा सके, जिसकी व्‍याख्‍या न की जा सके; अव्‍याख्‍येय)
 
 
• *Example: Her sudden disappearance is quite **inexplicable**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Inexplicable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Incredible**: impossible or very difficult to believe. (जिस पर विश्‍वास करना असंभव या बहुत कठिन हो; अविश्‍वसनीय)
 
• **Indelible**: that cannot be removed or washed out. (जो हटाया या धोया न जा सके; अमिट, अलोप्‍य, स्‍थायी)
 
• **Inevitable**: that cannot be avoided or prevented from happening. (जिसे घटित होने से रोका न जा सके, अवश्‍य होने वाला; अवश्‍यंभावी)
